scope: Start Page feature page and the Features page's Start Page tile, rewritten once public v1.51.0 replaced the four Start Page layouts with one Start Page and widget cards.

onePage.qualification: At v1.51.0 newtab.js applyLayout always uses one page ('Billboard is the one layout. What Ledger, Shelf and Tally showed comes back as optional widgets'). Customize has Widgets switches for Favorites and On your other devices (newtab.html), cards dragged by their grip to either rail or moved with arrow keys, resized from the bottom edge to fixed heights and reset by double-click (newtab.js, src/main/start-widgets.js), and a Shortcuts stepper from 1 to 12 (default 6). A Sent to this device card shows whenever something is waiting. Migration keeps what Ledger, Shelf or Tally showed (LAYOUT_WIDGETS in start-widgets.js). Widgets, their places and sizes and the shortcut count are device-local (settings.js newtabWidgets, never in SYNCED_KEYS); wallpaper color and clock keys sync. Shortcuts rank local history, private tabs neither feed nor show them, hidden tiles stay in page storage, and icons come from local caches with no new request (pages.js, main.js, top-sites.js). Nothing calls sendNewtabLayoutUsed at v1.51.0; mahjong_play is the Start Page's only usage event. newtab-backdrop.js continues the wallpaper behind the Island.

mahjongSets.qualification: v1.49.0's release notes and What's New 1.49: three tile sets, Porcelain, Carved and Inlay, moving to the next set after every three boards cleared in a row. The v1.51.0 source keeps the three sets (src/renderer/pages/mahjong-exact-{porcelain,carved,inlay}-*.png).

retiredWording: A different starting point, whenever you want.
A large clock, your weekly blocked-request total, frequently visited sites, and your named groups. Billboard is the default; change layouts from the start-page footer or Settings → General.
A simple list of Favorites and named groups. When you opt into sharing tabs, Ledger also shows tabs from your other devices.
Favorites as tiles, with named groups and a weekly blocking total underneath.
Favorites and groups beside a day-by-day chart of blocked requests this week.
Billboard ranks ordinary browsing history on this device. Its site icons come from locally cached artwork; drawing the row makes no new request to those sites or a favicon service.
Remove a site from Billboard when you do not want it there. That choice stays local and does not delete its history. Private tabs neither contribute to nor receive the history-derived row.

Mahjong games, records, and streaks are not cloud-synced. Billboard’s ranking, cached artwork, and hidden tiles also stay local. Your choice among the four start-page layouts can sync through Personal’s optional Sync. If you enable usage measurement, Blanc can count fixed layout names and the first real Mahjong move per app session, without game state or browsing data; private-tab feature activity is excluded.
Pick Ledger, Billboard, Shelf or Tally for new tabs. Billboard brings your frequent sites from local history, and Tally puts a big clock front and centre.
Your layout choice can follow you through Sync; history stays on this device.
Your Start Page color choices can sync through Personal’s optional Sync too, while your own image stays on this device.
Four layouts for your regular sites and groups, over a time-of-day scene, your own image or a color.
Every footer also opens Mahjong in its own tab and leaves your Start Page in place.
Choose your Start Page layout, wallpaper and clock.

Right-click the Billboard clock, or open Customize and choose Clock. Pick Instrument Sans, Instrument Sans Condensed, Inter or Roboto Flex, then set its weight and, with Instrument Sans or Roboto Flex, how tall it stands.
